title: PostgreSQL connection pool saturation during morning rush
root_cause_description: Connection pool reached maximum limit due to unindexed query holding locks, causing orders-api to timeout.
resolution_summary: Resolved by restarting connection pooler, terminating long-running idle transactions, and scaling max pool connections.

title: Async batch worker memory leak
root_cause_description: Unbounded cache in batch processing caused heap exhaustion and container SIGKILL (OOMKilled).
resolution_summary: Resolved by clearing cache references, restarting worker deployment, and increasing memory limit by 1GiB.
